Description
Designed for undergraduate students, American Collegiate LA allows students to earn recognized first-year university credits that are eligible for transfer to top-ranked institutions. Students study alongside peers on the UCLA main campus which is top 20 nationally ranked by U.S. News & World Report. This elite first-year program prepares international students to seamlessly continue as a year 2 student here or at other highly ranked universities.
